description: This file defines a function to resolve image mentions in text into data URLs, supporting image validation, size limits, and ignore rules. It includes interfaces for options and results, and helper functions for path validation and deduplication.

classes.name: ImageMemoryTracker
classes.description: A class for tracking total memory used by images during processing.

methods.name: resolveImageMentions
methods.description: Resolves local image file mentions in text into data URLs, respecting size limits, support, and ignore rules.

methods.name: isPathWithinCwd
methods.description: Checks if a given absolute path is within the current working directory.

methods.name: dedupePreserveOrder
methods.description: Removes duplicate strings from an array while preserving order.
